Role Overview


	The Ideal Inventory Officer will ensure proper inventory management, proper safekeeping of stock items, accuracy and effectiveness of stock reordering and stock level maintenance. Prepare and submit daily/weekly/monthly stock usage reports.


Key Responsibilities


	Receiving of new stocks and proper stock taking both physically and on the ERP platform and the relevant sheet

	Monitor stock movement and conduct regular stock counts to reconcile discrepancies.
	Raising of requests on Odoo for purchase of parts and other items used by the fleet/refurbishment team.
	Analyze and monitor request trends to identify fast moving and slow moving stock. This will help avoid tying down funds.
	Carry out any other task assigned.


Requirements


	Minimum of an HND /&nbsp; Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or any relevant fields
	Minimum experience of 2 years.
	Inventory Management and reporting skills
	Strong interpersonal and communication(written and oral) skills.
	Excellent understanding of Inventory Control principles and practices.
	Proficient in MS Office/Google Workspace.
	Good Maths SkillsCritical and analytical thinking.
	Accuracy and Attention to detail.
	Confidentiality and Thoroughness.


Want to Join Us? Here&rsquo;s Why You Should


	At MAX, we encourage diversity and are open to meeting just about anyone with the right passion and skill set regardless of looks, gender, sexual orientation, color, tribe, nationality, and disability.

	Drive: We are building a team where everyone is a leader and therefore run on internal motivation
	Empathy: We have a clear understanding of the problem we are trying to solve and its impact on Africans, we are committed to providing a lasting solution.

	Diligence: We take great pride in our work.
	Candor: We value open and honest communication
	Collaboration: We are a team of passionate, innovative optimists, solving challenging problems and creating an impact.
	Bias for Technology: We automate everything


What You&rsquo;ll Get:


	Competitive pay &amp; benefit
	Health insurance cover
	Frequent performance chats &amp; reviews
	High performing &amp; passionate team members + fun work culture.

Inventory Officer Job at Max Drive




        
    

        
        Max Drive - We are a team of passionate people and a leading technology-enabled company driven by a vision to solve the mobility challenges in Africa. We want to get people and goods to their destinations hitch-free. It is personal for us because we understand the frustration of epileptic transportation. We are making mobility safe, affordable, accessible, and sustainable through the deployment of high-performance technologies and operators.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Inventory Officer

Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo
Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Overview
     

            
    




	The Ideal Inventory Officer will ensure proper inventory management, proper safekeeping of stock items, accuracy and effectiveness of stock reordering and stock level maintenance. Prepare and submit daily/weekly/monthly stock usage reports.


Key Responsibilities


	Receiving of new stocks and proper stock taking both physically and on the ERP platform and the relevant sheet
	Issuance of parts to refurbishment team and proper documentation of parts issued out
	Issuance of engine oil for maintenance, and documentation on ERP platform and the relevant sheet
	Monitor reorder level and determine reorder quantity of stock items by evaluating and analyzing internal customers request patterns.
	Weekly review of stock level & initiation for replenishment on Odoo to maintain optimal and timely availability of stocks.
	Monitor stock movement and conduct regular stock counts to reconcile discrepancies.
	Raising of requests on Odoo for purchase of parts and other items used by the fleet/refurbishment team.
	Analyze and monitor request trends to identify fast moving and slow moving stock. This will help avoid tying down funds.
	Carry out any other task assigned.


Requirements


	Minimum of an HND /  Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or any relevant fields
	Minimum experience of 2 years.
	Inventory Management and reporting skills
	Strong interpersonal and communication(written and oral) skills.
	Excellent understanding of Inventory Control principles and practices.
	Proficient in MS Office/Google Workspace.
	Good Maths SkillsCritical and analytical thinking.
	Accuracy and Attention to detail.
	Confidentiality and Thoroughness.


Want to Join Us? Here’s Why You Should


	At MAX, we encourage diversity and are open to meeting just about anyone with the right passion and skill set regardless of looks, gender, sexual orientation, color, tribe, nationality, and disability.


The MAX Work Environment:


	Drive: We are building a team where everyone is a leader and therefore run on internal motivation
	Empathy: We have a clear understanding of the problem we are trying to solve and its impact on Africans, we are committed to providing a lasting solution.
	Humility: We are committed to continuous learning and improvement. We learn, unlearn and relearn
	Initiative: We welcome novel ideas and encourage creativity
	Diligence: We take great pride in our work.
	Candor: We value open and honest communication
	Collaboration: We are a team of passionate, innovative optimists, solving challenging problems and creating an impact.
	Bias for Technology: We automate everything


What You’ll Get:


	Competitive pay & benefit
	Health insurance cover
	Frequent performance chats & reviews
	High performing & passionate team members + fun work culture.

Assistant Photographer Job at Edo State Civil Service Commission




        
    

        
        The Edo State Civil Service Commission is vested with the responsibilities of treating matters concerning the State Civil Service with respect to Appointments, Promotions, Discipline, Confirmation of Appointments, Transfers, Retirements, Petitions and Other related matters.

Applications are hereby invited from suitably qualified candidates to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Assistant Photographer

Job Location: Edo
Grade Level: 06

Qualifications
Applicants must possess the following qualifications:
     

            
    




	National Technical Certificate (NTC Modular) in Photography or its equivalent.
	Final trade test certificate in photography or its equivalent, plus at least one year post-qualification cognate experience.
	National skill qualification (NSQ, Level 1-3).


Important Information and Notice


	Interested candidates should complete the online application form using the link above. After opening the link, click the NEXT button below to begin your application.
	Candidates may only apply for 1 position on this publication. Multiple applications will result in disqualification.
	Edo State Government does not require candidates to make any payments to any person or organization in respect of this  recruitment exercise.
	Equal opportunity is guaranteed for all Candidates for this free, fair and merit driven recruitment exercise.

	Optimize floor layouts, racking systems, and storage configurations to maximize cubic utilization, dock throughput, and traffic flow.

Facilities Maintenance & Asset Upkeep:

	MBA or relevant certifications is an advantage.
